title: mentha arvensis subsp. canadensis
intro: Mentha arvensis subsp. canadensis, commonly known as Canadian wild mint or American wild mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Mentha arvensis subsp. canadensis include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve muscle spasms, reduce swelling, and thin mucus, making it easier to expel. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
